notes: Primary pilot path is one Google Drive folder explicitly shared Viewer-only with the Atlas connector identity; no public-link sharing and no whole-Drive OAuth grant.
Manual Sync now and scheduled polling share one idempotent path and detect new/changed CSV files using Drive file ID, metadata and content fingerprint.
Raw CSV remains in Drive and is process-and-discard in Atlas; durable storage is limited to connector state, file checkpoints, normalized signals, changes and provenance.
End-customer PII, payment secrets and customer-level profiling are prohibited from normalized data, logs, memory and model input.
Device CSV upload remains a secondary fallback; Google Drive webhooks, XLSX, provider write-back, new ranking rules and analytics dashboards remain out of scope.
No production release, deployment, EAS/OTA or production database mutation is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner explicitly approved the detailed Level 2 Google Drive pilot scope and instructed implementation to start.

Product Owner approved selected-folder-only read access, no public-link sharing, raw-file non-retention and exclusion of customer PII. DEC-12 implements this through a Viewer-shared folder without whole-Drive OAuth.
Product Owner instructed Atlas to start working after approving the Level 2 connector workflow; implementation is feature-branch only and remains subject to exact-head certification.
